source.check: Nominations from the Frontier Sentinel (6 May 1939, p. 5).

note: Triennial election of the Kilkeel Rural District Council, polled at the end of May 1939. There was no contest: every division was filled by nomination or by the retiring member continuing in office. The Brackenagh nomination was withdrawn. Filed on 1939-06-01, the polling day for county council and rural district elections in Co. Down that year (confirmed); previously filed under 1939-05-31 (verification 5 Nov 2026). The nominations list (Frontier Sentinel, 6 May 1939, p. 5, page image read) has sixteen divisions with Rostrevor printed as two seats (seventeen members) and no Drumreagh entry; Drumreagh reappears as a single-member division in 1946. Returned unopposed.
